row: Welcome to Get Up & Grow! My name is Sara Brummer and I'm a pediatric physical therapist and mom of two!  As an experienced "theramom"  I'm here to offer fun tips and practical advice for helping your little one to grow, move, and play.    From tummy time to toe walking this channel offers a wealth of knowledge on how to promote development, strength, alignment, and gross motor skills so that your little one can fully participate in their most important job....PLAY!!
